title: Vehicle Imports
description: We import your dream car to your exact spec from Japan, UK, Dubai and Thailand. From auction bidding to customs clearance at Mombasa and delivery to your doorstep in Nairobi, we handle every step — with transparent pricing and weekly photo updates.
features: Auction sourcing from Japan, UK & UAE

title: Car Sales
description: Hand-picked local, imported and foreign-used vehicles, each inspected on our lift before listing. Every car comes with verified mileage, accident history and honest advice on running costs. Trade-ins welcome.

title: Custom Styling
description: Body kits, suspension drops, alloy swaps, ambient lighting, exhaust systems and full restomod builds. If you can dream it, our workshop on Mombasa Road can build it — with proper fitment, no shortcuts.

title: Vinyl Wraps
description: Full and partial colour-change wraps in gloss, satin, matte, chrome and colour-shift finishes. We use premium cast vinyls with plotter-cut precision, wrapped in our dust-controlled bay. Fully reversible and paint-safe.

title: PPF — Paint Protection Film
description: Self-healing, stone-chip-proof urethane film that keeps your paint factory-fresh. From a front-end kit to a full-body wrap, we offer both standard and top-tier hydrophobic films with a workmanship guarantee.

title: Window Tinting
description: Premium nano-ceramic films that cut heat and UV while keeping you on the right side of the law. We tint to legal visible-light-transmission levels and give every install a lifetime no-bubble warranty.
